Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-N at 2948 N
                              Narragansett Ave - App No. 21149
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                           ORDINANCE




BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as

shown on Map No. 7-N in the area bounded by




A line 120.20 feet south of and parallel to West Wellington Street;


16 foot public alley next west of and parallel to North Narragansett Avenue;


A line 90.20 feet south of and parallel to West Wellington Street;


And North Narragansett Avenue




to those ofa B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.




Common Address of Property: 2948 North Narragansett Avenue
